name: Faceless Educational Short

delivery_notes: emphasize the mechanism and payoff words

visual_language.motion: subtle-to-medium; one new visual idea at a time
visual_language.typography: large readable sans, 1-2 impact words per beat
visual_language.captions: phrase chunks, phone-readable, avoid duplicate center text
visual_language.color: clean contrast with one accent color

preferred_sources: local generated placeholders only when factual proof is not required
asset_strategy.generated_visual_policy: Allowed for concept visuals; do not present as evidence.

sound.sfx: small whooshes, ticks, pops, and UI cues only on meaningful reveals

qc: first 3 seconds create a reason to keep watching
every claim has a visual plan
captions are readable at phone size
no generated visual is treated as factual evidence
asset_manifest.json has entries for every final asset
